name: Blackrock Mountain
summary: In Blackrock Mountain, rival armies fight above depths scarred by fire and war. Ragnaros's summoning raised the volcano between the Burning Steppes and the Searing Gorge, and its roots now hold dwarven halls.

sections.title: A Cataclysmic Origin
sections.body:
Blackrock Mountain rose from the War of the Three Hammers two and a half centuries ago. The united armies of Ironforge and the Wildhammer clan threatened to destroy the Dark Iron dwarves. So Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan reached into the earth for a weapon, and his spell broke the barriers between worlds. It brought Ragnaros the Firelord to Azeroth.

The blast tore apart the Redridge range, carved out the Searing Gorge and Burning Steppes, and hurled a vast volcano into the sky. Thaurissan died in the destruction. The surviving Dark Iron clan was bound to serve the Firelord forever. They carved Shadowforge City deep among the mountain's roots.

sections.title: Citadel of Ash and Blood
sections.body:
Blackrock Mountain claimed a grim place in history during the First and Second Wars. After Stormwind was sacked, Orgrim Doomhammer purged the Shadow Council and made Blackrock Spire the Horde's fortress capital. The mountain remains a battlefield.

Dark Iron dwarves and their elemental master hold the fiery depths. Above, rogue Blackrock orcs, dragonkin, and their dark masters occupy the spires.

faq.answer: Blackrock Mountain rose about two hundred and fifty years ago during the War of the Three Hammers. Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan sought power beneath the earth to defeat rival dwarven clans. His spell summoned Ragnaros the Firelord and unleashed the blast that raised the volcano.

faq.q: Why is it named Blackrock Mountain?
faq.answer: No account names the first person to call it Blackrock Mountain. The name also belongs to the Blackrock orcs. During the Second War, Orgrim Doomhammer's Horde made Blackrock Spire its capital, and Blackrock remnants still hold it.

faq.q: Who controls Blackrock Mountain right now?
faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarves hold the halls of Shadowforge City and serve Ragnaros. Above them, Blackrock remnants and black dragonkin dominate Blackrock Spire.

faq.q: What zones connect through Blackrock Mountain?
faq.answer: Interior paths and chains through Blackrock Mountain link the Searing Gorge to the north with the Burning Steppes to the south.

angles.text: For dwarves, Blackrock Mountain marks a dark chapter in their history. The Dark Iron clan's folly cost them their freedom and scarred the Eastern Kingdoms.
For the Horde, Blackrock Spire recalls bondage and bloodshed under Doomhammer. Rogue orcs who reject Thrall's leadership now contest it.
